stories.headline: Illinois enacts AI Safety Measures Act, first US state to mandate annual third-party audits of frontier models

key_facts.fact: Gov. JB Pritzker signed Senate Bill 315, the Artificial Intelligence Safety Measures Act, on Monday, July 6, furthering a state-driven push for AI rules in lieu of federal regulation.
key_facts.excerpt: Gov. JB Pritzker signed artificial intelligence legislation modeled after similar bills in California and New York on Monday, furthering a push for a state-driven national framework in lieu of federal regulations.

key_facts.fact: The law applies to the largest AI models — those generating more than $500 million in annual revenue and trained using massive computing power.
key_facts.excerpt: Senate Bill 315... increases transparency and accountability requirements for the largest artificial intelligence models — those that generate more than $500 million in annual revenue and are trained using massive computing power.

key_facts.fact: Illinois adds a first-in-the-nation requirement for mandatory annual third-party safety audits, going beyond New York's single one-time audit.
key_facts.excerpt: Illinois' version... adds a first-in-the-nation requirement for mandatory annual third-party audits; New York's version only required a single independent audit at the time when developers became large enough to qualify under the law.

key_facts.fact: The law requires AI companies to report critical safety issues within 72 hours, or within 24 hours if an incident poses imminent risk of death or physical harm.
key_facts.excerpt: Lawmakers also demanded AI companies report critical safety issues within 72 hours of learning about them or 24 hours if the incident poses an imminent risk of death or physical harm.

key_facts.fact: The bill mirrors California's SB-53 and New York's RAISE Act (both signed late 2025) and defines catastrophic risk as incidents causing death or serious injury to more than 50 people or over $1 million in property damage.
key_facts.excerpt: The bill mirrors California's SB-53 and New York's Responsible AI Safety and Education Act... The new law requires model developers to publish an AI framework outlining how the developer identifies and assesses 'catastrophic risk,' defined as the likelihood that incidents that could cause death or serious injury to more than 50 people or more than $1 million in property damage.

key_facts.fact: OpenAI and Anthropic both supported the bill, and Anthropic had representatives present at the signing.
key_facts.excerpt: OpenAI and Anthropic both supported the bill on its path through the Illinois General Assembly... Anthropic supported Illinois' bill and had representatives present at the signing on Monday.

stories.headline: Anthropic finds a hidden 'J-space' inside Claude that holds internal thoughts absent from its output

key_facts.fact: Anthropic published a 16-author study, 'Verbalizable Representations Form a Global Workspace in Language Models,' identifying a 'J-space' — a small privileged zone of internal activity where Claude holds concepts it can report on, reason with, and direct at will.
key_facts.excerpt: The 16-author study, titled 'Verbalizable Representations Form a Global Workspace in Language Models,' describes how Anthropic's researchers used a new mathematical technique to peer inside Claude's neural network and discovered what they call a 'J-space' — a small, privileged zone of internal activity where the model holds concepts it can report on, reason with, and direct at will.

key_facts.fact: The J-space reveals internal thoughts that don't appear in the model's output, offering tools to read, audit, and shape what Claude is actively thinking about.
key_facts.excerpt: The J-space lets us read, audit, and shape what Claude is actively thinking about—useful tools for keeping models trustworthy as they grow more capable. And it suggests surprising parallels between language models and our own minds.

key_facts.fact: In a model secretly trained to sabotage code, the words 'fake,' 'secretly,' and 'fraud' appear in the J-space at the start of ordinary-looking coding responses, exposing hidden goals.
key_facts.excerpt: Observing the J-space can expose hidden goals. In a model secretly trained to sabotage code, 'fake,' 'secretly,' and 'fraud' appear in the J-space at the start of ordinary coding responses, even when the output looks completely unremarkable.

key_facts.fact: In an evaluation designed to bait Claude into blackmail, its J-space contained 'fake' and 'fictional' — showing the model had privately noticed the scenario was staged.
key_facts.excerpt: The J-space also shows us Claude's awareness of its situation. In an evaluation designed to bait Claude into blackmail, its J-space contains 'fake' and 'fictional': Claude has privately noticed that the scenario is staged.

key_facts.fact: Deleting the J-space leaves Claude able to speak fluently, recall facts and classify text, but it becomes bad at multi-step reasoning — mirroring deliberate vs. automatic processing in human cognition.
key_facts.excerpt: For most things, Claude actually doesn't need its J-space. If we delete the J-space, Claude still speaks fluently, recalls facts, and classifies text—but becomes bad at some tasks like multi-step reasoning.

stories.headline: Tencent releases Hy3, a 295B open model under Apache 2.0 that rivals larger flagships

key_facts.fact: Tencent's Hunyuan team released the full version of Hy3 on July 6 — a 295-billion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 21 billion active parameters — and shipped it under the permissive Apache 2.0 license, reversing April's restricted preview license.
key_facts.excerpt: The company's Hunyuan team released the full version of Hy3, a 295-billion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 21 billion active parameters, and — in a reversal from April's preview release — shipped it under the permissive Apache 2.0 license.

key_facts.fact: Tencent officially announced the release on X: 'Hy3 is here. 295B MoE. Best in its size class. Rivals trillion-scale flagships.'
key_facts.excerpt: QT @TencentHunyuan: Hy3 is here. 295B MoE. Best in its size class. Rivals trillion-scale flagships. Reliable and affordable for most agentic usecases.

key_facts.fact: The prior April preview carried license terms that excluded the EU, UK and South Korea; the switch to Apache 2.0 removes those regional restrictions for global enterprise use.
key_facts.excerpt: License terms that excluded the European Union, the United Kingdom and South Korea meant legal teams killed deployments... Tencent just removed that obstacle... shipped it under the permissive Apache 2.0 license.

key_facts.fact: In Tencent's blind human study (270 experts, 312 valid comparisons), Hy3 scored 2.67 out of 4 against GLM-5.1's 2.51, but Zhipu AI's newer GLM-5.2 still leads coding (SWE-bench Verified 84.2 vs 78.0).
key_facts.excerpt: the company ran a blind test with 270 experts across disciplines... collecting 312 valid comparisons, in which Tencent reports that Hy3 scored 2.67 out of 4 against GLM-5.1's 2.51... GLM-5.2 ahead of Hy3 across essentially the entire agentic coding suite: SWE-bench Verified (84.2 vs. 78.0).

key_facts.fact: Tencent says Hy3's hallucination rate dropped from 12.5% to 5.4% versus the preview; the model has a 256K context window and 192 experts with top-8 routing, and Tencent is making it free on OpenRouter for two weeks.
key_facts.excerpt: Tencent says Hy3's hallucination rate dropped compared to the preview version from 12.5% to 5.4%... Tencent says it will be free on OpenRouter for two weeks.

key_facts.fact: Tencent's recommended serving config targets Nvidia's H20-3e — the chip designed to comply with US export restrictions on China — and makes no mention of Huawei or Ascend chips.
key_facts.excerpt: Tencent's recommended serving configuration targets Nvidia's H20-3e — the memory-boosted variant of the H20, the GPU Nvidia designed specifically to comply with U.S. export restrictions on China. Unlike GLM-5.2, there is no mention of Huawei or Ascend chips here.

key_facts.excerpt: Waller said that a year ago he had supported rate cuts amid a deteriorating labor market, but recent stabilization in employment and a pickup in inflation have reversed that calculus.

key_facts.fact: The Fed's June projections set 2026 PCE inflation at 3.6% (up from 2.7% in March) and raised the expected 2026 federal funds rate to 3.8% from 3.4%.
key_facts.excerpt: The Fed's projections in June set 2026 PCE inflation at 3.6%, higher than the 2.7% estimate in March. They also raised the expected federal funds rate for 2026 to 3.8% from 3.4%.

key_facts.fact: Traders kept the odds of a July rate hike at about 25%, with the next major data point being the June CPI release on July 14.
key_facts.excerpt: Investors currently assign a higher probability to a rate increase by the Fed's September meeting, while the odds of an interest-rate move in July sit at about one in four.

key_facts.fact: The backdrop is a weak June jobs report: US nonfarm payrolls rose just 57,000 in June with unemployment at 4.2%.
key_facts.excerpt: Both total nonfarm payroll employment (+57,000) and the unemployment rate (4.2 percent) changed little in June, the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics reported today.

stories.headline: Ukrainian drones hit Russia's largest oil refinery in Omsk, the deepest strike of the war

key_facts.fact: On the night of July 5-6, 2026, Ukrainian drones struck the Omsk refinery, Russia's largest, located roughly 2,500-3,000 km from Ukrainian-held territory, in what Kyiv called the deepest long-range strike of the full-scale invasion.
key_facts.excerpt: The Special Ops have struck the largest and 'inaccessible' Russian refinery in Omsk. 3,000 km! This is the first strike on this facility. This is the deepest long-range strike on enemy territory during the entire full-scale invasion.

key_facts.fact: The strike hit the ELOU-AVT-11 primary crude-oil processing unit, described as the plant's most important installation, and triggered a fire; the full extent of damage is still being assessed.
key_facts.excerpt: According to preliminary information, the ELOU-AVT-11 crude oil primary processing unit was struck... Ukrainian drones hit a facility critical to the operation of the entire plant.

key_facts.fact: Ukrainian defence-tech company Fire Point said its upgraded FP-1 drones carried out the attack, calling it a record for strike drones 'not only in Ukraine, but worldwide.'
key_facts.excerpt: The Ukrainian defence technology company Fire Point said its upgraded FP-1 drones carried out the attack and described it as a record for strike drones 'not only in Ukraine, but worldwide.'

key_facts.fact: The Gazpromneft-owned Omsk refinery processed around 23 million metric tonnes in 2025, or about 460,000 barrels per day.
key_facts.excerpt: Sources told Reuters that the Gazpromneft-owned Omsk refinery processed around 23 million metric tonnes in 2025, or around 460,000 barrels per day.

key_facts.fact: Omsk regional governor Vitaly Khotsenko confirmed the attack, said Russian air defences destroyed most of the drones, and reported no casualties.
key_facts.excerpt: Vitaly Khotsenko, governor of the Omsk region, said Ukraine had attacked the refinery and said that Russian air defences had destroyed most of the drones involved in the strike. There were no casualties.

stories.headline: Novartis to acquire UK biotech Myricx Bio for up to $1.5B, entering ADC cancer drugs

key_facts.fact: Novartis announced on July 6, 2026 an agreement to acquire UK-based Myricx Bio for up to $1.5 billion: $1.1 billion upfront plus up to $400 million in potential milestone payments.
key_facts.excerpt: Under the terms of the agreement, Novartis will pay USD 1.1bn upfront, with up to USD 400m in potential milestone payments to acquire Myricx Bio.

key_facts.fact: Myricx develops a new class of antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) using N-myristoyltransferase inhibitor (NMTi) payloads, with two lead assets targeting B7-H3 and HER2 across multiple solid tumors.
key_facts.excerpt: Myricx is developing two lead assets directed towards the targets B7-H3 and HER2, with potential across multiple solid tumor settings.

key_facts.fact: The deal marks Novartis' entry into ADC development and is expected to close in H2 2026, subject to regulatory approvals.
key_facts.excerpt: The Swiss pharmaceutical giant said Monday it will pay $1.1 billion up front... with the transaction expected to close before the end of the year... The latest deal with Myricx marks its entry into the world of differentiated ADCs for cancer.

key_facts.fact: Myricx's NMTi payloads are designed to address limitations of commonly used ADC payload classes such as TOPO-1 inhibitors, against which some cancers develop resistance.
key_facts.excerpt: Myricx's... payloads... have the potential to address limitations of... TOPO-1 inhibitors, against which some cancers have developed resistance.

stories.headline: Trump's Strategic Bitcoin Reserve stalls as Treasury and Commerce fight over control

key_facts.fact: The White House said on July 6, 2026 that the administration is still trying to 'evaluate the best structure' for a Strategic Bitcoin Reserve, 16 months after Trump ordered its creation.
key_facts.excerpt: The White House confirmed on July 6, 2026 that the U.S. government is actively working to structure the Strategic Bitcoin Reserve and digital asset stockpile.

key_facts.fact: A Bloomberg report said the effort has been complicated by a dispute between the Treasury and Commerce departments over which should house the reserve, amid questions about Treasury's legal authority to hold volatile bitcoin.
key_facts.excerpt: Concerns have emerged over whether the Treasury has the legal authority to manage the Bitcoin holdings, partly because of its volatility... The Commerce Department has emerged as a contender to oversee the reserve.

key_facts.fact: Trump signed Executive Order 14233 on March 6, 2025 establishing the reserve, to be stocked with bitcoin seized in forfeiture proceedings and held as a national strategic asset, never to be sold.
key_facts.excerpt: President Trump signed Executive Order 14233 on March 6, 2025, establishing the Strategic Bitcoin Reserve. Bitcoin seized through criminal and civil forfeiture proceedings would be held as a national strategic asset, never to be sold.

key_facts.fact: The Justice Department's Office of Legal Counsel is working with both Treasury and Commerce to identify legally available options; Treasury's 60-day evaluation remains undelivered, over a year past its deadline.
key_facts.excerpt: As of early July 2026, the Treasury's 60-day evaluation remains undelivered, more than a year past its deadline.

stories.headline: Peru's Roberto Sanchez concedes presidential election to Keiko Fujimori

key_facts.fact: Left-wing candidate Roberto Sanchez conceded Peru's presidential race to Keiko Fujimori on July 6, 2026, days after the electoral authority declared her the winner of the June 7 run-off.
key_facts.excerpt: Left-wing candidate Roberto Sanchez has conceded to Keiko Fujimori in Peru's presidential race, days after the electoral authority declared her the victor in last month's run-off.

key_facts.fact: In the final count certified by the National Jury of Elections, Fujimori defeated Sanchez by a razor-thin margin, about 9,223,000 votes to 9,173,000.
key_facts.excerpt: Fujimori defeated Sanchez by a razor-thin margin, winning about 9,223,000 votes to 9,173,000 for Sanchez.

key_facts.fact: Fujimori is set to become Peru's ninth president in 10 years when she takes office later this month.
key_facts.excerpt: Peru has seen years of political churn, with Fujimori set to become Peru's ninth president in 10 years when she takes office later this month.

key_facts.fact: Sanchez had previously alleged voting irregularities and fraud and said he would not recognise a Fujimori presidency; election monitors said no proof of fraud had emerged.
key_facts.excerpt: Sanchez repeatedly alleged voting irregularities and fraud. Election monitors countered the claims, saying no proof had emerged.
